title: Week 11 — Modern pleading: the entire chapter
shortTitle: Week 11 — Modern pleading: the entire chapter
summary: Read all of Chapter 8, including the material not assigned for formal case presentation. Named cases are Twombly, Iqbal, Tellabs, Ziervogel, Garcia, Krupski, and Surowitz. Pay close attention to Rules 8, 9, 11, 12, and 15 in the supplement.
